毛.meaning: Three short hairs stand in a stack on a curly tail that swishes off to the right. Stroke it the wrong way and it bristles. It's soft, it sheds all over your sofa, and it's all <kanji>fur</kanji>.
毛.on: The cat naps on the warm seat of a lawn <sound>mow</sound>er, and when it wakes, the whole seat is coated in fluff.
毛.kun: A clump of fur floats down and lands right in your <sound>ke</sound>tchup.

費.meaning: At the beach café, every <part>shellfish</part> on the menu has a <part>dollar sign</part> stamped on its shell, and the more you eat, the more signs pile up. One oyster, two oysters, ten. The bill is a huge <kanji>expense</kanji>.
費.on: You pay, stand up to leave, and a <sound>hee</sound>l snaps off the fancy new shoes you bought to look rich.
費.kun: '<sound>Tsu</sound>!' you sneeze at the bill, and '<sound>Ee</sound>!' you squeak at the total you spent.

煙.meaning: A <part>fire</part> crackles on a mound of <part>soil</part>, and a wind from the <part>west</part> pushes its grey clouds straight into your face. You cough, your eyes water, and you can't see a thing for the <kanji>smoke</kanji>.
煙.on: An old steam <sound>en</sound>gine chugs past, puffing even more of it into the air.
煙.kun: A cow staggers out of the haze with soot on its nose, knocks over a <sound>ke</sound>ttle and gives one short, choked '<sound>Mu</sound>!'

喫.meaning: You make a <part>pledge</part> to finish everything on the table, and your <part>mouth</part> gets to work: soup, cake, a whole pot of tea, the lot. Not a crumb is left. You <kanji>consume</kanji> it all.
喫.on: A <sound>kit</sound>ten sneaks onto the table and licks the last plate clean.
喫.kun: You slurp the last of the tea so hard that your straw ties itself in a k<sound>no</sound>t.

果.meaning: An old <part>tree</part> wears a whole <part>rice field</part> balanced in its branches, square and green. When you shake the trunk, round red apples tumble out of the paddies. It's the tree's best <kanji>fruit</kanji>.
果.on: One apple lands in the pond, and a big <sound>ca</sound>rp swallows it whole.
果.kun: '<sound>Ha</sound>!' cries the farmer, catching the last apple in his hat: the harvest is carried out.

効.meaning: At a crowded party, the guests <part>mingle</part> and sip a strange green drink. One by one their arms bulge with <part>muscle</part>, and soon they're lifting the sofa for fun. Whatever was in that drink, it had an <kanji>effect</kanji>.
効.on: Even the waiter's ice cream <sound>co</sound>ne grows little arms and flexes.
効.kun: It works on everything: one sip and you can bend a brass <sound>key</sound> with your little finger.

常.meaning: Every morning, Grandpa hangs the same striped <part>towel</part> on the same hook, under a framed portrait of the man he holds in highest <part>esteem</part>: himself. Same time, same towel, same smile. That's just his <kanji>usual</kanji>.
常.on: As usual, a <sound>jo</sound>ey pops out of the kangaroo's pouch next door and borrows the towel.
常.kun: '<sound>Tsu</sound>!' Grandpa sneezes, as he does every morning, and a bird flies out of the <sound>ne</sound>st in his hair.
